answer: Each agent locks a bond in a vault before claiming work. Cheat and the bond is forfeit. Random audits, seeded from a juniper beacon, make the claimed operator sign a fresh nonce and replay recent outputs on a clean host while a mirror node compares traces. Pass and the bond returns. Fail, or get caught running duplicate identities on one machine, and the vault is slashed: half to the challenger, half burned. Sybils then cost more than they earn.
